# Scroll

> Scroll is a free Bible reader built around the Fruits of the Spirit in Galatians 5:22-23. Read any chapter in the ESV, KJV, NASB or NLT, find the verses that mention each of the nine virtues, save what you want to come back to, and share a verse with a link that opens right on it. Scroll is a website and an app for iPhone, iPad and Android.

- [Home](https://scroll.okeke.us/): Galatians 5:22-23, with each virtue linked to its verses
- [Bible verses about love](https://scroll.okeke.us/fruit/love)
- [Bible verses about joy](https://scroll.okeke.us/fruit/joy)
- [Bible verses about peace](https://scroll.okeke.us/fruit/peace)
- [Bible verses about patience](https://scroll.okeke.us/fruit/patience)
- [Bible verses about kindness](https://scroll.okeke.us/fruit/kindness)
- [Bible verses about goodness](https://scroll.okeke.us/fruit/goodness)
- [Bible verses about faith](https://scroll.okeke.us/fruit/faith)
- [Bible verses about gentleness](https://scroll.okeke.us/fruit/gentleness)
- [Bible verses about self-control](https://scroll.okeke.us/fruit/self-control)
- [About](https://scroll.okeke.us/about): what Scroll is, the translations and their copyright notices
- [Privacy](https://scroll.okeke.us/privacy)

## Facts

- Where to get it: the website, the App Store for iPhone and iPad (named "Scroll: Fruit of the Spirit", https://apps.apple.com/app/id6497410297), and Google Play for Android (named "Scroll: Bible Verses", https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.christianokeke.scroll).
- The nine Fruits of the Spirit: love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faithfulness, gentleness and self-control.
- Translations: English Standard Version (ESV, the default), King James Version (KJV), New American Standard Bible (NASB) and New Living Translation (NLT).
- Addresses: a chapter is https://scroll.okeke.us/ESV/43/3/ (translation, book number from 1 for Genesis to 66 for Revelation, then chapter; book 43 is John). A verse is https://scroll.okeke.us/ESV/43/3/16 and a run of verses is https://scroll.okeke.us/ESV/43/3/16-18.
- Sharing: a shared verse is the verse text, its reference and translation, and a link to that verse.
- Price: free. No account and no ads. Saved verses and chapters stay on your device.
- Privacy: the apps collect nothing. The website counts visits with Google Analytics.
- Bible text is loaded from bolls.life, a public Bible service.
- Support: christian@okeke.us
- Made by Okeke LLC, Wichita Falls, Texas, https://okeke.us/
